prompt: Complete countNonBlankLines so it reads a text file with java.nio.file.Files and returns how many of its lines contain at least one non-whitespace character.
explanation: Files.readAllLines reads the whole file and splits it into a List<String>, one entry per line, without the line terminators. String.isBlank() is true for empty or whitespace-only strings, so counting the lines where it is false gives exactly the non-blank total. Declaring throws IOException lets the checked exception propagate to the caller instead of being swallowed, which is the right choice for a small utility method.
hints: java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(path) returns a List<String> with one element per line.
line.isBlank() is true for "" and for lines containing only spaces or tabs -- count the lines where it is false.
You do not need try/catch here: the method's throws IOException clause passes the checked exception to the caller.
